name: Improvised Diversion
body:
You are well practiced at distracting your enemies and making a quick exit.

Benefit(s): You can make a Bluff check to create a diversion to hide and move up to your speed as a move action. In addition you gain a +2 bonus on Bluff checks made to create a diversion. To create a diversion you make a Bluff check DC equal to 10 plus each opponent’s modifier to sense motive checks.
